# Will YOU Be My Hero? — Draft Combine

> A phone-first app for a fantasy football draft combine: live timing, a leaderboard, trading cards, packs, trades and end-of-day awards.

## Pages

- [The Vault](/players): Every player's trading card, rarity and collection.
- [Leaderboard](/leaderboard): Ranked combine results across all stations.
- [Live](/live): The running clock and current athlete on the course.
- [Running order](/order): The randomized order athletes run in.
- [Awards](/awards): Superlatives voted on by the group.
- [Draft](/draft): The draft board and picks.
- [League](/league): League standings and history.
- [TV board](/tv): The big-screen broadcast view of the combine.
